title: defaults channel
fix: replace with - conda-forge and add - nodefaults
why: defaults is short-hand for repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/main and pkgs/r (plus pkgs/msys2 on Windows); organisations with 200 or more people need a paid Anaconda licence to use it.

title: anaconda channel (anaconda.org mirror)
why: the anaconda channel on anaconda.org is a mirror of defaults and is subject to the same terms.

title: repo.anaconda.com URL
fix: replace with conda-forge (or the repository URL your Anaconda licence gives you)
why: repo.anaconda.com/pkgs/main, pkgs/r and pkgs/msys2 are the defaults channels covered by the Anaconda Terms of Service.

title: pkgs/main, pkgs/r or pkgs/msys2 short name
why: pkgs/main, pkgs/r and pkgs/msys2 resolve to repo.anaconda.com, the licensed defaults repository.

title: dependency pinned to a paid channel
fix: drop the channel:: prefix or pin to conda-forge::
why: a defaults::, anaconda:: or pkgs/main:: prefix downloads that package from Anaconda's repository even when the channels list is clean.

title: .condarc default_channels points at Anaconda
fix: set default_channels to conda-forge or remove the key
why: default_channels is what the name defaults expands to on this machine, so every environment that uses defaults inherits it.

title: no nodefaults in the channels list
fix: add - nodefaults as the last channel
why: conda env create adds the channels from your conda configuration after this list; Miniconda and Anaconda installers configure defaults there.

title: conda-forge mixed with an Anaconda channel
fix: keep conda-forge and remove the Anaconda channel
why: switching to conda-forge only removes the licence question when the Anaconda channel is gone from the same list.
